claims: The National Security Agency (NSA) is a U.S. Department of Defense agency.
The NSA is located in Fort Meade, MD.
The NSA protects national security systems.
The NSA provides foreign intelligence to policymakers and military forces.
The NSA collects and analyzes foreign signals (communications, radar) to provide intelligence on adversaries.
The NSA secures U.S. national security systems against cyber threats.
The NSA secures U.S. information against cyber threats.
The NSA secures the Defense Industrial Base against cyber threats.
The NSA acts as a combat support agency.
The NSA provides intelligence to warfighters.
The Central Security Service (CSS) coordinates with the NSA to provide cryptologic support.
The National Security Operations Center (NSOC) monitors threats 24/7.
The NSA offers careers for professionals in intelligence analysis.
Intelligence analysis at the NSA involves evaluating foreign data.
The NSA offers careers for professionals in language analysis.
Language analysis at the NSA involves translating foreign intelligence.
The NSA offers careers for professionals in engineering and physical sciences.
Engineering and physical sciences at the NSA involve developing technology and cybersecurity tools.
The NSA offers careers for professionals in mathematics.
Mathematics at the NSA involves developing secure systems.
To work at the NSA one must be a U.S. citizen.
To work at the NSA one must be able to obtain a high-level security clearance.
To work at the NSA one must pass a polygraph examination and extensive background check.
The NSA operates under the authority of the director of national intelligence (DNI) to support foreign intelligence and counterintelligence purposes.
